# Security Policy

## Supported Versions
We actively secure and patch the latest version of this API.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.0.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.0.0 | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability
**Please do not open public GitHub issues for security vulnerabilities.**

If you discover a security vulnerability within this project, please report it privately by sending an email to **nthai0345842756@gmail.com**.

We will acknowledge your report within 48 hours and provide a timeline for the fix.
